reason: Minimal Test-Time Intervention detects high-entropy tokens during reasoning and applies selective classifier-free guidance only there, reusing the main model's KV cache to approximate the unconditional branch cheaply; it is a decoding-time algorithm, but its measured contribution is reasoning accuracy (+9.28% average) rather than inference-system performance.
title: Less is More: Improving LLM Reasoning with Minimal Test-Time Intervention
